P1.evidence: No setter to read back. A light agenda was set rather than the four-part frame — "before we get into anything else, I just want to make sure I fully understand what you're looking for" — with no agreement sought. The open question was asked well and produced the whole agenda for the call: "in your message, you mentioned wanting your wife to be a part of this. So help me understand what that actually looks like for you." He also opened by acknowledging the prospect for showing up rather than ghosting, which set a genuinely good tone.

P2.evidence: Baseline taken on 11 June. The injuries were restated by the prospect unprompted on this call and were not re-explored.

P3.evidence: Established on the earlier calls. Notably the rep did not reconnect to the grandchildren why at any point on this call, which was the strongest asset he had built.

P5.evidence: Third consecutive call with this prospect and still no consequence frame. It was applicable throughout — the rep was actively trying to close — and the material was sitting there unused: a fixed November race date, a race he could not finish last time, injuries that he says are worsening ("It takes longer for me to recover, and I get injured more easily now"), and his own statement that "I have to get in better shape either way." Instead of building the cost of waiting, the rep endorsed waiting: "And I think this is the right way to approach that."

P6.evidence: No fresh commitment check was run for the core offer; the rep went straight from the objections into the one-month trial. For the downsell he did ask a light version — "do you feel like you want to try that out?" answered "Yeah, I do" — and acted on the yes, which is why P6c is partial rather than a miss. The all-in question was never asked on any of the three calls with this prospect. When hesitation surfaced the script says return to Phase 5, and again there was no Phase 5 to return to.

P11.evidence: Scored against the product that actually closed, a self-serve subscription rather than the coached programme. Payment was not collected: the link was sent and confirmed received but not completed — "I can't do it right now, because I have to get to the bank." There is no Trevor onboarding call and no client agreement attached to this product, so those steps do not apply. The rep did walk him through the platform in detail via screen share — the movement library, the nutrition protocol, Primal Mastery 1 and 2, the tracker, the weekly live session and the community — which covers the spirit of the final step, but he did not confirm access, did not confirm the payment went through, and left the call without knowing whether the prospect was in.

objection_plays.detail: The rep opened the play correctly and by the book — "because, of course, like, you're looking for certainty. That's what I'm hearing" — and the prospect rejected the premise outright: "No, I'm not looking for certainty, because I know that's on me... I'm just looking to be able to judge." That is a well-aimed move meeting a prospect it does not fit, and the rep had nowhere to go afterwards. No bridge, no plane, no burned-before. Worth noting for the playbook: this prospect's doubt was evidential, not emotional, and OE has no branch for that.

Two isolation attempts. The first was rejected — "Let's put the finances aside" met with "I can't put it aside because I'm nickel-and-diming everything." The second landed and was well phrased: "is it that you don't see the value or you don't have this like $1,200 to check it out for yourself?", answered "Both." No financial picture was rebuilt on this call, which is defensible given it was covered on 11 June, but the answer "both" was the important one and the value half of it was never worked.

A clear and detailed spouse trigger — "unless I push back in my arena... if I push back on her, then she's like, well, then why the heck are you spending money on this other stuff?" — answered with "Yeah, I feel you" and nothing else. Not one scripted move. The prospect even opened the door to including her in a conversation and it was not taken up.

"I think emotionally I need to get past this stage to know where the heck I sit financially" and "give me a holler at August 1st". The rep not only skipped the play, he affirmed the objection: "And I think this is the right way to approach that." Given a household fighting over $500 and a half-million-dollar reserve wiped out, that was probably the decent thing to do — but it should be a deliberate, permitted exception rather than an unrecorded judgement call.
He did not ask for time to think; every blocker he raised was specific and evidenced.

The largest gap on this call. The prospect asked, in substance, for proof: testimonials and outcome data from men over 50, how many have completed, average starting and ending stats, and the chance to speak to one. There is no scripted answer and apparently no asset. The rep declined references on policy, noted testimonials are voluntary, and then argued that proof is unobtainable in principle — "with fitness, you won't actually know until you check it out for yourself." That reframe converts a reasonable request for evidence into an unanswerable question, and a financial advisor was never going to accept it.

Clinical gap again, and this time it converted. "I've got a frozen elbow... I can't get my arm to go straight", torn ankle tendons and ligaments, plus his own "it may be premature for me" — none of it was answered, and the prospect ended the call signed up to an unsupervised programme including steel maces and clubs. There is still no screen, no clearance step and no stop condition.

The cheaper-substitute objection the playbook already lists as unscripted, in its strongest form yet: a local in-person trainer offering side-by-side coaching plus nutrition for less than $1,200 a month, plus a gym membership he already pays for. The rep tried the "you're not buying a PT" reframe, was immediately shown it did not apply, and then withdrew — "maybe I am biased", "I don't want to get into an argument." Conceding the frame rather than rebuilding value on delivery model, programming or self-sufficiency.

notes: Handled with real decency — he acknowledged the prospect for showing up, did not fight a man whose finances had collapsed, and left the door open for August. But three plays that were all clearly triggered went unrun, and the two objections that actually decided this call were the two the script cannot answer: prove it works for men my age, and is this safe with a frozen elbow and a torn ankle. The first needs a marketing asset. The second needs a process rule. Neither is a coaching problem, and no amount of rep skill fixes them.
